# Lint rules regex compile limit and legacy fancy-regex rules

The lint rules crate compiles user patterns with RegexBuilder::size_limit(8 * (1 << 20)). A pattern over that limit returns Error::CompiledTooBig, and the rule loader reports the rule id instead of aborting. The regex crate has no lookaround or backreferences, so rules that need them live in rules/legacy/ and use fancy-regex.

## Summary

Diagnosed and fixed repeated pod evictions on node worker-node-7 caused by DiskPressure: /var/lib/containerd was 94% full of unused images because imageGCHighThresholdPercent had been raised to 95 in the kubelet config (written by the node-config DaemonSet), so image garbage collection never ran before the eviction threshold. The fix set imageGCHighThresholdPercent back to 80 in the node-config DaemonSet, restarted the kubelet on worker-node-7, and pruned unused images with `crictl rmi --prune`. Verified via `kubectl describe node worker-node-7 | grep DiskPressure` that DiskPressure is now False (KubeletHasNoDiskPressure) and evictions stopped; the threshold change propagates to other nodes when their kubelets restart.

- worker-node-7

- /var/lib/containerd

## Summary

Investigated a 25-minute Android CI job and reduced it to ~9 minutes. In .github/workflows/android.yml, the actions/cache@v4 key hashed every file under app/, causing cache misses on any source change; the key was changed to hash only **/*.gradle.kts and gradle/libs.versions.toml, and the Gradle configuration cache was enabled in gradle.properties. Verified via `gh workflow run android.yml && gh run watch`: the android / build job completed in 9m12s with the cache restored from the gradle dependency key.

## Summary

Fixed a flaky Playwright test checkout.spec.ts that failed ~1 in 10 CI runs with a 5000ms click timeout on the Pay button ("element is not stable"). Root cause: the Pay button slides in after the /api/shipping-quote response arrives, so the click raced the animation. Changes: the test now waits for the /api/shipping-quote response before clicking, and playwright.config.ts sets reducedMotion to 'reduce' so the button does not animate under test.
